questions.qtext: EPROM contents can be erased by exposing it to
questions.solution:
(a)
EPROM contents can be erased by exposing it to ultraviolet rays.
The ultraviolet light passes through a window in the IC package to the EPROM chip where it releases stored charges. Photons of the UV light cause ionization within the silicon oxide, which allows the stored charge on the floating gate to dissipate. Thus, the stored contents are erased.

questions.qtext:
Which of the following statements are correct regarding flash type ADC?
1. Flash type ADC also called as the parallel comparator type ADC or simultaneous ADC is the fastest ADC.
2. All comparator outputs are connected to a priority encoder, which produces a digital output corresponding to the input having highest priority.
questions.solution:
(c)
A flash ADC (also known as a direct-conversion ADC) uses a linear voltage ladder with a comparator at each “rung” of the ladder to compare the input voltage to successive reference voltages. The output of these comparators is generally fed into a priority encoder, giving the digital output. Due to simultaneous comaprisons, they can carry out the conversion in a single step, and hence is the fastest among all ADCs.

questions.qtext: You are designing a 5 to 32 decoder using 3 to 8 decoders and a single 2 to 4 decoder. How would you connect the enable inputs of the 3 to 8 decoders?

options.text: Connect the enable inputs of 3 to 8 decoders to a common ground.
Connect the enable inputs of the 3 to 8 decoders to the outputs of the 2 to 4 decoder.
Connect the enable inputs of the 3 to 8 decoders to the least significant bit (LSB) of the input.
Connect the enable inputs of the 3 to 8 decoders to the most significant bit (MSB) of the input.

questions.solution:
(b)
A 5-to-32 decoder can be built using a 2-to-4 decoder and four 3-to-8 decoders. Using the two MSB inputs, Lthe 2 to 4 decoder generates 4 outputs which are connected to the enable inputs of four 3 to 8 decoders to generate 32 outputs. The remaining three input bits are connected to the input lines of all four 3-to-8 decoders to determine the specific output within the enabled group.
